svg.text: Rectangle: an action the adversary performed
Ellipse: a state the attack required or established
Dashed outline: an observation beside the attack,
Arrows read downward: the node below depends
Separate arrows into an action: any one input was
Circle at an action's top-left corner: kill-chain phase,
Circle at a state's top-left corner reading PRE: a
condition that held before the attack
Circle at a state's top-left corner reading RES: a
Tags at an action's top right: ATT&CK technique,
Tags at an action's bottom right: mitigation, keyed
Number at an action's bottom-left corner: how
feasible the step was judged to be, 0 to 10
T1547.001: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
M1035: Limit Access to Resource Over Network
M1042: Disable or Remove Feature or Program
